description: Rule-based entity and value extraction with normalised values: dates (ISO, numeric with dmy/mdy, month names, relative "next Friday" / "in 3 days" resolved against a reference date), times with time zones, money (symbols, ISO codes, crypto tickers, k/m/bn scales), percentages and basis points, quantities with units, durations in seconds, URLs, emails, hashtags, @mentions, $cashtags, organisations (legal suffixes) and titled persons. Code-point offsets, overlap resolution, type filter. Offline, deterministic, English. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/entity-extract

dateOrder.description: How to read ambiguous numeric dates like 03/04/2026

referenceDate.description: Anchor for relative dates and missing years (default today, UTC)
